mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_callback WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{event}
SELECT * FROM payment_callback WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM payment_callback WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id FROM payment_callback q LEFT JOIN payment_authorization employee ON q.payment_kind='EMPLOYEE' AND employee.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND employee.id=q.employee_payment_id LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_authorization supplier ON q.payment_kind='SUPPLIER' AND supplier.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND supplier.id=q.supplier_payment_id LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=CASE q.payment_kind WHEN 'EMPLOYEE' THEN employee.application_id WHEN 'SUPPLIER' THEN supplier.application_id END LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=CASE q.payment_kind WHEN 'EMPLOYEE' THEN employee.round_no WHEN 'SUPPLIER' THEN supplier.round_no END WHERE q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt} ORDER BY q.next_attempt_at,q.received_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM payment_callback WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY received_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM payment_callback WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (received_at<#{receivedAt} OR (received_at=#{expectedReceivedAt} AND id<#{id})) ORDER BY received_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT state_json FROM payment_callback_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND callback_id=#{id} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 50
